result.summary: The layout is largely coherent, but there are a few visual inconsistencies: the favourite (heart) button styling differs between the two 'Popular right now' cards, the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab for the displayed Home content, and one carousel thumbnail has a mismatched pale background.

issues.description: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) while the screen displayed is clearly the Home feed (delivery address, promo banner, restaurant carousels).
issues.suggestion: Sync the active tab state with the current route so 'Home' is highlighted on the home feed.

issues.description: The favourite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards are styled differently: the ramen card has a white circular button with a dark outline heart, while the pizza card has a dark circular button with a white heart. Inconsistent and the dark variant reads as an 'active/filled' state.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent button treatment (e.g. white translucent circle with dark outline heart) for all cards, reserving a filled style only for the actual saved/favourited state.

issues.description: The first 'Fastest near you' thumbnail (Green Bowl Poké) has a light grey/near-white background while the sibling thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look uneven and the white '15–25 min' badge low-contrast on it.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail backgrounds (or apply a consistent dark gradient overlay) and ensure the time badge has sufficient contrast on light images.
